skills.name: company-due-diligence
skills.description: Runs a structured KYB / due-diligence review of a company — resolves the entity, then pulls official-registry details, directors, shareholders, corporate group structure and financials into one report. Use when the user asks to run due diligence, a KYB check, a compliance review, or to "check out" / "vet" a company.
skills.description_zh: 开展结构化企业 KYB 或尽职调查，确认实体并汇总官方注册、董事、股东、集团结构和财务信息。

skills.name: company-snapshot
skills.description: Produces a short profile of one company — identity, size, financial headline and digital footprint — without the full KYB dossier. Use when the user asks "what is this company", "tell me about", "look up" or "profile" a company, or pastes a company website or LinkedIn URL and asks who they are.
skills.description_zh: 为单个企业生成简短档案，包含身份、规模、财务要点和数字足迹，适用于名称、官网或 LinkedIn URL 查询，不制作完整 KYB 档案。

skills.name: prospect-list
skills.description: Builds a target account list from firmographic filters — country, industry, size, revenue — then optionally finds and enriches contacts at each company. Use when the user asks to find, search or build a list of companies matching criteria, to source leads or accounts, or to get contacts at a set of companies.
skills.description_zh: 按国家、行业、规模和收入等企业特征筛选目标账户名单，并可查找补全各公司联系人，用于企业潜客与账户获取。
